title: Apothem Learning Signal
description: One captured signal in the opt-in continuous-learning loop. A signal is the raw observation the capture stage records when the operator has opted in; the extraction stage scores patterns over a set of signals. The shape is neutral: it carries no tool-specific or vendor-specific identifier.

id.description: Stable signal identifier, unique within a learning store.

kind.description: Signal taxonomy. correction: an operator corrected an action. confirmation: an operator confirmed an approach. observation: a recurring pattern noticed in the work.

summary.description: One-line statement of what was observed.

tags.description: Tags used to group related signals during pattern extraction.

payload.description: Free-form structured detail accompanying the signal.

captured.description: ISO 8601 timestamp the signal was captured.
